title: Underwater Training
paragraphs: “Oh my, I want to enjoy Naofumi-chan’s company a little longer. Here, one more drink.”
As expected, Sadina’s sister is trying to get Father to drink more.
“Are you still trying to get me to drink? My stomach is already sloshing, and I’m feeling a bit off.”
“But Naofumi-chan doesn’t get drunk at all.”
“Apparently, he doesn’t.”
“Oh my…”
Is it just my imagination, or does it look like Sadina’s sister is tagging along just to get Father drunk? But most likely, she just wants to have a drinking contest.
“Well, Sadina-san seems pretty drunk already, and since we’re going hunting tomorrow, we should head back.”
“Got it~ See you later.”
“Phew… finally free.”
The panda, looking utterly exhausted, leaves the tavern. Father either had the bill with him or had already split the tab beforehand because he was seen settling the payment.
“Alright, everyone. I’m sure you’re all sleepy, so let’s head back.”
“Okay.”
“That was kind of fun.”
“Really? I thought it was a bit boring. I did see all sorts of people, though.”
“Um… did I manage to be of help?”
“Yeah, having everyone around was a big help. Come on, Motoyasu-kun, let’s go home. Sadina-san, you should go home and get some rest too.”
“Yeah, I’ll do that.”
“By the way, where does Sadina-san sleep?”
Father asks Sadina’s sister. Probably at some inn around here.
“That’s a secret.”
Saying that, Sadina’s sister waves to Father and disappears into the bustling crowd of Zeltoble.
“She’s a mysterious person in many ways.”
“Is that so?”
In the village, Sadina’s sister was someone everyone relied on. She’s definitely strong and dependable, but I never quite got that impression.
“She seemed well-connected in slave-related matters… I wonder what she does for a living.”
“I don’t know. Even in the first world, I met Sadina’s sister after we were already in the village.”
“Huh… from what I’ve picked up, she seems to know about some shady business like slave hunting. I heard she used to be in Melromarc before.”
Wasn’t she a warrior who lived in Sadina’s village? I’m not too familiar with that part either.
“Judging by her reaction to Imia and the others, she seems to be protecting someone like I am.”
“Father has good instincts. Subtly asking her might be a good idea.”
“Yeah. Also, when I first met her, I noticed a faint trace of a slave crest around her chest… but when I saw her today, it was gone.”
He observes things closely. I was completely unaware of Sadina’s sister. I had been watching Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan the whole time.
“In this country, it seems that slaves who double as mercenaries exist, so it’s not that surprising. Sadina-san… she gives off the impression of being quite capable.”
“I heard she was everyone’s reliable big sister.”
“Yeah, it feels that way… From what I’ve heard, it might be better to ask Eclair-san or the queen of Melromarc.”
“Do you think they know?”
“Since she was a demi-human from Melromarc… she might be well-known.”
“I see.”

Father seems to think it’s better to know how Sadina’s sister ended up as one of his subordinates, although I’m not particularly curious about it. Well, if it’s a command from Father, I’ll spare no effort.
“Anyway, everyone’s getting sleepy, right? Let’s go back and sleep.”
“Sakura’s sleepy… I want to sleep here.”
“Just wait a little longer.”
“Let’s go home, Gaelion.”
“Naofumi and I will enjoy a night stroll, nano.”
“…I’m sleepy.”
“You can sleep on Gaelion’s back, big sister. Imia, do you want to ride and sleep too, nano?”
The rival has transformed into dragon form. The mole waves his hand in front of his face.
“I’m fine.”
“Okay… let’s go home then.”
“Understood.”
And so, we ended up returning to the lodging fairly early and went to sleep.
Will Father succeed in recruiting the panda tomorrow? --- The next morning. Ren arrived through the portal, as if to give a report.
“Good morning.”
“Oh, Ren. Good morning. How’s Itsuki and Imia-chan’s relatives? Any problems?”
“There’s no problem with Imia’s companions. Today, I plan to go to the village where I used to stay with Éclair. If all goes well, great. If not, we’ll have to secure another location.”
“Yeah… I see. What about Itsuki?”

“The queen has looked into it, and a few candidates have been identified. Itsuki occasionally drops by the castle, so I’ll report when he does. If all goes well, we might find them tonight or maybe tomorrow.”
“Yeah… I hope we can protect them.”
“Indeed.”
Ren and Father are looking at me with a sigh, aren’t they? What is it?
“So, Naofumi. How’s it going on your end?”

“I’ve gotten things to a certain point, but I still need to build a little more trust. Today, we’re all going hunting together, and I’m planning to nurture some goodwill there before hiring them as mercenaries.”
Ren crossed his arms and nodded several times.
“So, things are going smoothly?”

“More or less. But Ren, if I manage to recruit them successfully, they’ll be comrades we’ll fight alongside… Their way of thinking is probably quite different, so there’s a chance of conflict. I need you to understand that.”
“I know. How many comrades do you think I’ve had by now?”
“You leave everything to me… Well, whatever. That’s the plan for today, so I think we’ll be back around evening.”
“Got it. I’ll be back soon too. As for Motoyasu… well, just do whatever you want.”
“Ha ha ha, I will fight for Filo-tan and Father!”
Until the world achieves true peace, I will keep moving forward and fighting. That being said, what I need to do now is check Yuki-chan’s condition and prepare for the race.
“Well then, Motoyasu-kun, Yuki-chan. See you later.”
“We’re off now!”
“Let’s go!”
Yuki-chan and I waved to Father and the others and headed toward the facility related to the filolial race, where the breeders were. But we quickly returned to Father.
“Huh? Motoyasu-kun, did you forget something?”
Father seemed to be preparing various things for today’s trip to the sea, as planned. It looked like he was preparing swimsuits for Sakura-chan, the rival, the assistant, and the mole.
“No, that’s not it.”
“Yes, that’s not it. It’s a message from the breeder.”
Yes, when I went to see the breeder, he instructed me to give Yuki-chan some training… exercise. So, I’m planning to do exactly what I was told.
“Apparently, Yuki-chan is supposed to do pool training today. I’ve been entrusted with that task.”
“Hmm… to train without putting strain on her legs, maybe?”
“That’s what he said. My legs are perfectly fine though…”
“Since it’s an important period before the race, I guess he doesn’t want to push you too hard. So, you’ll be swimming in the pool?”
“As long as Yuki-chan swims, anything is fine.”
There were detailed instructions about the distance and such. But with Yuki-chan, there’s no problem.
“He mentioned that we could use a waterway, but he asked that we do it somewhere away from people if possible. He wants to keep it a secret until the race.”
The breeder seems to have thought of everything. When showing Yuki-chan to anyone involved, he instructed her to stay in her filolial form and not to speak.
“Then, do you want to come with us?”
“Indeed! It’s perfect for Yuki-chan’s training.”
“That sounds good. I’ll have to leave partway through, but I’ll go with you.”
Well, Yuki-chan has already learned to swim well on Cal Mira Island, so I don’t think there will be any problems.
“Alright, then wait until it’s time. I’ll be making lunch in the meantime.”

Come to think of it, Father had borrowed the kitchen in the lodging and was cooking. He was packing enough food for everyone into lunch boxes. And so, Yuki-chan and I ended up going to swim at the sea with Father.
